project.name: agentbox
project.summary: Build and launch modular devops toolbox containers. Install AI agents inside the container with the in-container wizard.

briefing.title: What this is
briefing.body: agentbox builds flavor-tagged images (core, k8s, terraform, pulumi, full) and launches them with capsule. The default profile is sealed isolation; opt into mounts or use filtered/trusted when you need more.

briefing.title: Two wizards
briefing.body: This host wizard builds and runs capsules. After you are inside a container, run wizard to install Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Grok, and other agent CLIs (downloaded at runtime, not baked into Hub images).

tasks.title: Start a sealed session
tasks.summary: Mount a work directory at /work with git identity and open network. No Docker socket, SSH, history, or GitHub tokens unless you add flags.
tasks.details: Creates or reattaches a container named after the directory. Use --recreate when changing profile or mounts.

inputs.name: -D
inputs.help: Gives the container root-equivalent control of the host daemon.

inputs.name: --history
inputs.prompt: Share shell history with the host?

tasks.title: Start a filtered session
tasks.summary: No credentials; HTTP(S) only through the egress allowlist proxy.
tasks.details: Uses wsams/agentbox-proxy (built from proxy/) and egress.conf. Add domains with --allow.

inputs.name: --allow
inputs.prompt: Extra allowlisted domain (optional, empty to skip)

tasks.title: Start a trusted session
tasks.summary: Full conveniences: Docker socket, SSH, history, GitHub tokens, sudo.
tasks.details: The container is no longer a security boundary relative to the host Docker daemon.

tasks.title: Run run-agent in a capsule
tasks.summary: Ensure a container exists for the directory, then exec run-agent (AGENT_CMD or first installed agent).
tasks.details: If no agent is installed yet, attach and run wizard inside the container first.

tasks.title: Attach to a running capsule
tasks.summary: Open an interactive shell in an existing container.

tasks.title: Tear down a capsule
tasks.summary: Remove the container plus its egress proxy, BuildKit builder, and network.

tasks.title: Build an image flavor
tasks.summary: Build one of the published presets: core, k8s, terraform, pulumi, or full.

inputs.name: --push
inputs.prompt: Push to Docker Hub after build?

tasks.title: Build with custom feature groups
tasks.summary: Turn feature groups off/on for a one-off or variant tag.

inputs.name: --with
inputs.prompt: Groups to force on after WITHOUT

tasks.title: List feature groups
tasks.summary: Print every toggleable image feature group.

tasks.title: Build the egress proxy image
tasks.summary: Build wsams/agentbox-proxy for the filtered profile.

tasks.title: Install AI agents inside a capsule
tasks.summary: Use the in-container wizard to download Cursor, Claude, Copilot, Grok, and others.
steps: Pick an agent installer (or wizard --list). Each download is subject to that vendor's terms.
Then run the agent CLI, or: run-agent

tasks.title: Run Renovate now
tasks.summary: Trigger the Renovate workflow outside the nightly schedule.
tasks.details: Requires RENOVATE_TOKEN on the repo and gh authenticated to that repository.
